candidate_record.candidate: Age-aware update rule (NOT LIVE, shadow only)
candidate_record.built_from: Engine v2.3 release chain (national.py history with weight credit 0.25 and 0.170 s/L -> engine/lab.py -> freeze_b5_national_common.py -> engine/release_v2.py -> b10/scripts/build_v22.py) in a sandbox (/tmp/ua/research), with the rule switched on

rating_update_settings.RATING_TAPER_AGEFLOOR: engine/frames/age_at_run.parquet (age at each completed run, from the production Engine v2.3 frame)

candidate_record.rule_in_words: a defeat counts at most 12 lengths in the performance figure (the recorded margin is never changed); a run better than expected moves the rating m times as far, m = 1 + 0.3 x exp(-n/6), where n = the horse's runs held before this run; a horse aged 5 or more at the run counts as n >= 24 (m about 1.006). Runs worse than expected move the rating as in Engine v2.3.
candidate_record.rule_maths: innovation u = (perf_capped - race mean perf_capped) - (mu - race mean mu); Kalman gain K = var/(var + s^2); if u > 0: mu += K * m * u else mu += K * u; m = 1 + 0.3 exp(-n_eff/6); n_eff = max(n_held, 24) if age >= 5 else n_held
candidate_record.career_start_treatment: n_held counts runs in our history only (from Oct 2022); true career starts are not used. Known limitation (Batch 19 B6): by Nov 2026 most horses aged 5+ with few runs held are genuinely lightly raced (TAB form, 26-27 Nov: 28 of 30), so the age floor now treats them as exposed.
candidate_record.approved: Damo 27 Nov 2026 (Batch 19 brief A2): build as a new frozen shadow with an independent prospective clock; not production
